_note: 심경 변화(narrative) 유형. 학술유형 제외. grammar/vocab/order/insert/summary/writing만. summary는 anxious→relieved 심경 변화.

passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip.
He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped on the road.
The driver announced that they had a mechanical problem.
Daniel grew nervous about missing his train.
Without hesitation, he getting off the bus and took a taxi to the station.
Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time.
When he finally reached the station, he found out that the train was delayed by ten minutes.
Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 'he ___ the bus and took a taxi'에서 and로 과거동사 took과 병렬되는 정동사가 필요하므로 과거형 'got off'가 와야 한다. 현재분사 'getting off'는 문장의 동사가 될 수 없어 비문이다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①접속사 when, ③keep -ing의 worrying, ④수동태 정동사 the train was delayed, ⑤once절의 과거동사 settled는 모두 옳다.

passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip.
He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped on the road.
The driver announced that there was a mechanical problem.
Daniel grew calm about missing his train.
Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station.
Still, he kept worrying about not arriving in time.
When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes.
Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 기차를 놓칠까 봐 Daniel은 '불안해진(nervous)' 것이어야 한다. 그래서 택시로 갈아타고 계속 걱정했다는 뒤 내용과 이어진다. '침착한(calm)'은 정반대 감정이라 부적절하므로 nervous로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②망설임(hesitation), ③걱정하며(worrying), ④지연된(delayed), ⑤안도(relief)는 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip when the bus he was riding suddenly stopped.

blocks.A: Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station, yet he kept worrying about not making it in time.
blocks.B: The driver announced that there was a mechanical problem, and Daniel grew nervous about missing his train.
blocks.C: When he finally reached the station, he learned the train was delayed by ten minutes, and once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.

order.explanation_ko: 버스가 멈춘 뒤(주어진 글), 고장 안내와 불안(B), 택시로 갈아타고도 계속 걱정함(A), 역에 도착해 지연을 알고 안도함(C) 순서이다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 안도는 마지막이고, (A)의 '택시로 갈아탐'은 고장 안내(B) 뒤라야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station.

passage_marked.text: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip.
He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped, and the driver announced a mechanical problem.
Daniel grew nervous about missing his train.
Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time.
When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 불안해진 Daniel이 택시로 갈아타는 '행동'이다. 불안을 느낀 문장(③) 뒤이자 '그래도(Still) 계속 걱정했다'는 문장(④ 뒤) 앞에 와야 자연스럽다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 택시로 옮겨 탄 행동이 있어야 ④ 뒤의 'Still, 그래도 걱정했다'가 자연스럽게 이어진다.

passage: Daniel was heading to the train station for an important business trip.
The bus he was riding suddenly stopped because of a mechanical problem.
He grew nervous about missing his train and quickly took a taxi instead.
Even in the taxi, he kept worrying about not arriving in time.
When he reached the station, he discovered that the train was delayed by ten minutes.
Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
summary.summary_template: As his bus broke down on the way, Daniel felt __(A)__ about missing his train, but he became __(B)__ when he learned it had been delayed.
summary.explanation_ko: 버스가 고장 나 기차를 놓칠까 (A)anxious(불안)했으나, 기차가 지연되었음을 알고 (B)relieved(안도)했다. ⑤.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 anxious, (B)는 relieved여야 한다. calm/excited/bored나 annoyed/frightened/disappointed는 심경 변화와 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: Daniel은 자신의 기차를 놓칠까 봐 불안해졌다.
writing.answer: Daniel grew nervous about missing his train.
writing.explanation_ko: grow nervous(불안해지다) + about + 동명사 missing his train.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그가 마침내 역에 도착했을 때, 그는 기차가 10분 지연되었다는 것을 알게 되었다.
conditions: When으로 시작하는 시간 부사절을 쓸 것
found out과 수동태 was delayed를 사용할 것
writing.answer: When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes.
writing.explanation_ko: When + 과거 시간절 + 주절 found out + 명사절(the train was delayed).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of ___________.
writing.explanation_ko: 무사히 기차에 탄 뒤 내쉰 한숨은 '안도(relief)'의 한숨이다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station.
writing.answer: 망설임 없이, 그는 버스에서 내려 역까지 택시를 탔다.
writing.explanation_ko: without hesitation(망설임 없이), got off the bus(버스에서 내리다), took a taxi(택시를 타다).
